subject.title: Subagent sessions persist after completion, main session becomes unresponsive

question: Should completed one-shot subagent sessions be retained as history, hidden/archived from active/default views, or deleted after final delivery according to archiveAfterMinutes?
rationale: Current source and docs disagree, and each direction changes user-visible history, attachment retention, Control UI status, and recovery behavior.

options.title: Retain but hide/archive by default
options.body: Keep completed subagent history inspectable while excluding terminal one-shot rows from active/default session and status views after final delivery settles.

options.title: Delete after final delivery/TTL
options.body: Make run-mode subagent cleanup remove child session rows according to archiveAfterMinutes, accepting reduced default history retention.

options.title: Keep current retention
options.body: Document that default cleanup=keep preserves completed rows and focus only on status honesty and manual maintenance tooling.

recommendation.title: Retain but hide/archive by default
recommendation.body: Keep completed subagent history inspectable while excluding terminal one-shot rows from active/default session and status views after final delivery settles.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad work across session locks, subagent cleanup, gateway listing, and task maintenance, making this the best available routing owner.
